interrupt_semantics: Stops a running turn; agent remains available. Does not document closing or releasing a completed child thread.
app_archive_api: set_thread_archived requires actual Codex thread identity. App list_threads does not expose these named agent child identities; no documented child-to-thread mapping or capacity release guarantee.
observed_live_agent_list: Root running; listed children completed; no active child needing interruption.
recovery: Coordinator must choose supported native capacity recovery or an already authorized execution surface that can launch fresh exact agents. Do not assume archive, interruption, or agent reuse releases thread capacity.
